- **The 382 figure:** Tobias posted 382 in this channel on the 14th. I still can't find anything on file to back it up, and nothing new has come in since I asked him for the signed paperwork.

I suggested Hollis put 40 on the account sheet unless Tobias produces a signed change. I left out the pricing.
